data.title: Khloé George gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Nov 13, 2023

## [Poor shipping and order quality](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65527e1a123740b73745019f)
After waiting for 3 weeks for my order, which I ordered on 10/21 and first week of November, it still had not shipped. Finally got my order and was sent 2 small ornaments and 2 large ornaments when I had ordered 4 Large. I wrote to customer service when I received the order on 11/10 and haven't heard from anyone in customer service.

November 10, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Nov 14, 2023

Hi Khloé, we’re so sorry to hear the vendor sent the incorrect ornaments. Apologies for the inconvenience this has caused. We can see you’ve been corresponding with our Customer Experience team this week, and they are working on a resolution. Please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with in the meantime.
